test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 16 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Vincov-19, the first indigenous drug to treat Covid-19, has been developed by synthesizing blood serum obtained from _______ immunised with spike glycoprotein of inactivated SARS-CoV-2 virus.
solution:
The correct answer is __**horses**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **CSIR-Centre for Cellular and Molecular Biology (CCMB)**,** VINS Bioproducts**, and the **University of Hyderabad (UOH)** has collaborated to create the drug **'Vincov-19'**.
 
• To create this drug, the **SARS-CoV-2 virus** is inactivated and injected into** horses**.
 
• The** antibodies** that are generated through the blood serum are synthesized and then purified and turned into a **drug**. this drug is then injected into humans to neutralize the **COVID virus**.
 
• **CSIR-Centre for Cellular and Molecular Biology (CCMB)**, is an **Indian fundamental life science research institute based in Hyderabad**.
 
• **UNESCO'S Global Molecular and Cell Biology Network have designated CCMB as a "center of excellence."** It is a leading research institute that conducts high-quality basic research and training in areas of** modern biology**, as well as promoting centralized national facilities for new techniques in interdisciplinary fields of **biology**.
 
• **On April 1, 1977**, it was established as a** semi-autonomous center**.
 
• **Phase 2 clinical trials of 'Vinco-19' **were conducted across multiple centers in the country involving over **200 patients and were completed in September**. These trials also included testing the **antidote** against the Omicron variant to ensure maximum coverage against the **virus and its known mutation.**
 
• One group of patients was given** VINCOV-19, along with Standard Care (SoC)**, and another group was given **Standard of Care only**. **VINCOV-19 showed an excellent safety profile in the phase 2 trials**. There were good and early improvements in the clinical condition of the patients administered VINCOV-19.
 
• **VINCOV-19 **contains **Equine polyclonal antibodies (EpAbs) **against the COVID-19 virus and comprises highly **purified F(ab)2 antibody** fragments that have a high **neutralizing** capacity against the **SARS-CoV-2 virus**.
 
• Since** neutralizing antibodies** could block the **internalization of SARS-CoV-2 to lung cells**, it was postulated that their passive administration should render maximal clinical benefits if they are applied at the early stages of the disease.
 
• **UoH Vice-Chancellor B.J. Rao** congratulated the team members for their efforts in completing phase 2 trials for VINCOV-19 and the academia and industry collaboration.
